title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1103 | 水上摩托、太空远行者、五只水獭宝宝
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🏍️ 一位骑手给摩托车装上大滑雪板，在水面上骑了四十多公里，创下世界纪录！
🛰️ 旅行者一号飞了快五十年，现在离我们整整一个光日远，打个招呼要等两天！
🦦 北卡罗来纳水族馆迎来了五只小小的亚洲小爪水獭宝宝，世界上最小的水獭！

📖 Word of the day: voyage（长途旅行）

🎮 二选一：骑摩托车在水面上飞驰，还是给旅行者一号发一句问候、等两天才收到回复？你选哪个？也问问爸爸妈妈！

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🏍️ A rider put big skis on his motorcycle and rode more than forty kilometres on water, setting a world record!
🛰️ Voyager One has been flying for almost fifty years and is now one light-day away, so one hello takes two whole days!
🦦 Five tiny Asian small-clawed otter pups, the smallest otters in the world, were just born at an aquarium in North Carolina!

📖 Word of the day: voyage

🎮 Would you rather: ride a motorcycle on water, or send a hello to Voyager One and wait two whole days for the answer? Ask your mom and dad too!

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. voyage（长途旅行）
a long journey, especially across the sea or through space
例：Voyager One is on the longest voyage ever!（旅行者一号正在进行有史以来最长的旅行！）

2. record（纪录）
the best ever result in something, like the fastest or the longest
例：He holds the world record!（他保持着世界纪录！）

3. otter（水獭）
a playful animal that swims and plays in rivers and seas
例：five tiny otter pups（五只小小的水獭宝宝）

4. pup（幼崽）
a baby animal, like a baby dog or a baby otter
例：five little pups（五只小幼崽）
